purpose: Development-only grouped cross-validation and model selection; no independent test score.
data_policy: Original 80-run development plus corrected former 80-run holdout are both development now. A fresh independent holdout is required for final accuracy.
candidate_policy: Predeclared Random Forest/XGBoost variants; equal base weight per run; selected Normal-class multipliers are part of development tuning.

packet.selection_note: Best candidate selected on these OOF folds; its selected score is development evidence, not an untouched final-test estimate.

flow.selection_note: Best candidate selected on these OOF folds; its selected score is development evidence, not an untouched final-test estimate.
